ios.desc:
With BitAlert, you can stop viewing price changes in cryptos non-stop throughout the day, and let us notify you when a significant price move occurs.

For instance, if the price of Bitcoin is trading at $50,000, you can set a custom price movement alert at 20%. This means that you'll receive a notification from us when Bitcoin moves to either $40,000 or $60,000.

We'll also re-adjust your notification basis, so you'll continue to get notified for further 20% price movements.

You can choose whatever percentage price movements you'd like, from 1 to 100%. 

You can also trust BitAlert to provide real-time updates on price movements for Bitcoin and Ethereum.

Privacy Policy: https://cuff.live/policy

Terms & Conditions: https://cuff.live/terms
